summary: All three press stages are present, with every golden shut height, stroke, pressure and dimension correctly bound to its machine, and the revision and dates are correct. It fails because the header stage number is wrong ('PP-010 to PP-080' instead of 1), and because it adds actionable specs that are not in the golden: D 513, top liner and cushion pin sizes, the F-PRD-17, F-QMS-6 and F-DVP-29 form references, hourly and per-lot sampling, and the micrometer least count. It also tells the operator to check draw dimensions with a hardness gauge. Rework rejects rusted or dented parts instead of repairing them, the thickness rework row and the draw tool size are missing, and the part list table is empty.
